pieces.Text: A dreamweaver replaces some of her patron's spells with the following: 2nd-sow thoughts (see below), 4th-dust of twilight (Pathfinder RPG Advanced Player's Guide), 6th-deep slumber, 8th-modify memory, 10th-dream, 12th- cloak of dreams (Advanced Player's Guide), 14th-ethereal jaunt, 16th-moment of prescience, 18th-astral projection.
